doc.projectIntro: Revised at your request: Kirsten Dodgen, Lexi Reid and Sandy Gaizley have been removed, and Gerioeneesa Bailey has been moved to Business Basic ahead of her departure. This quote covers Microsoft 365 licensing for 17 users — 14 on Business Standard and 3 on Business Basic — on a Microsoft NCE annual commitment billed monthly. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: Full desktop Office apps, 1TB OneDrive, Exchange, Teams and SharePoint. Assigned to: Alex Holmes, Ammer Gajadur, Andrew Hochfelden, Anthea Petersen, Bianca Van Rooyen, Braam Rakoma, Chane Tessener, Dominique Bennett, Jayson Theron, Melissa Robinson, Philip Williams, Stefan Hugo, Tarryn Gander, Thabiso Lelosa.
Web and mobile Office apps, Exchange, Teams and SharePoint. Assigned to: Hilda Allin, OC Alerts, Gerioeneesa Bailey.

doc.summaryNote: On the Business Basic downgrade for Gerioeneesa Bailey: she keeps her full mailbox, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive files, and can use Word, Excel and the other Office apps in the browser and on mobile — but Business Basic does not include the desktop Office applications, so anything she does in the installed desktop apps today would move to the web versions. If she needs the desktop apps until she leaves, keep her on Standard and drop the licence at the annual renewal or on departure. The two Copilot licences remain excluded; Jayson Theron and Stefan Hugo continue to license Copilot directly from Microsoft.
terms: This quote is valid for 14 days from the date of issue.
All prices exclude VAT at 15% unless otherwise stated.
Licensing is provided on a Microsoft NCE annual commitment, billed monthly. The 12-month term applies from activation and renews annually unless cancelled before the renewal date.
Licence counts can be increased during the term at the same per-user rate. Reductions take effect at the annual renewal.
Licences are assigned per named user as listed above. Reassignment between staff is supported at no additional cost.
Microsoft pricing is subject to OEM (Microsoft) price adjustments.
Microsoft 365 Copilot is not included in this quote.
Payment of the monthly licence fee is due in advance.
